# HTMX PRO — Complete Machine-Readable API Specification & Pattern Fixtures

## 1. Syntax & Attribute Reference

### `hx-state` / `<script type="application/json" hx-state>`
Declares local reactive state for a component subtree.
```html
<!-- Recommended: Script block (prevents quote-escaping issues) -->
<div class="card">
  <script type="application/json" hx-state>
  {
    "count": 0,
    "user": { "name": "Alice", "role": "admin" },
    "items": ["Item A", "Item B"]
  }
  </script>
  <button hx-on:click="count++">Count: <span hx-text="count">0</span></button>
</div>

<!-- Inline alternative -->
<div hx-state='{ "count": 0 }'>
  <button hx-on:click="count++">Count: <span hx-text="count">0</span></button>
</div>
```

### `hx-computed`
Declares reactive memoized derived properties. Automatically recomputes when dependencies change.
```html
<div hx-state='{ "price": 100, "qty": 2, "taxRate": 0.08 }'
     hx-computed='{ "subtotal": price * qty, "total": (price * qty) * (1 + taxRate) }'>
  <p>Total: $<span hx-text="total">0</span></p>
</div>
```

### `hx-model`
Two-way data binding for inputs, textareas, selects, checkboxes, radios.
- Modifiers: `.number` (parses to float), `.lazy` (binds to change instead of input), `.trim` (trims whitespace).
```html
<input type="text" hx-model.trim="username">
<input type="number" hx-model.number="price">
<input type="checkbox" hx-model="isActive">
<select hx-model="selectedRole">
  <option value="admin">Admin</option>
  <option value="editor">Editor</option>
</select>
```

### `hx-for`
Structural list rendering using standard `<template>` tags.
```html
<template hx-for="item in items">
  <div class="item-row" hx-text="item.name"></div>
</template>

<!-- With index -->
<template hx-for="(item, idx) in items">
  <div>
    <span hx-text="idx + 1"></span>: <span hx-text="item.title"></span>
    <button hx-on:click="items.splice(idx, 1)">Delete</button>
  </div>
</template>
```

### `hx-if`
Structural conditional mounting and unmounting of DOM elements.
```html
<template hx-if="user.isLoggedIn">
  <div class="user-profile">Welcome, <span hx-text="user.name"></span></div>
</template>
```

### `hx-show`
Display toggle (`style.display`) with transition animations.
```html
<div hx-show="isOpen" hx-transition="fade" class="modal-content">
  Modal Body
</div>
```

### `hx-on:event` / `@event`
Event listeners with modifiers.
- Modifiers: `.prevent`, `.stop`, `.self`, `.once`, `.window`, `.document`, `.outside`, `.debounce.300ms`, `.throttle.500ms`, `.enter`, `.escape`.
```html
<button hx-on:click.prevent="submitForm()">Submit</button>
<div hx-on:click.outside="isOpen = false">Dropdown Menu</div>
<input hx-on:keydown.enter="addItem()" hx-on:input.debounce.300ms="search()">
```

### `hx-validate`
Declarative client-side validation rules.
- Rules: `required`, `email`, `url`, `min:<len>`, `max:<len>`, `numeric`, `alphanumeric`, `pattern:<regex>`, `match:<field>`.
```html
<form hx-ext="form">
  <input name="email" hx-validate="required|email" hx-msg="Valid email required">
  <span hx-error-for="email" class="text-red-500 text-xs"></span>
  <button type="submit">Submit</button>
</form>
```

## 2. Common AI Hallucinations & What to Avoid

1. ❌ DO NOT write Vue's `v-for` or `v-if`.
   ✅ ALWAYS write `<template hx-for="item in items">` and `<template hx-if="condition">`.

2. ❌ DO NOT write React's `onClick={() => ...}` or `className="..."`.
   ✅ ALWAYS write `hx-on:click="..."` and `class="..."` or `hx-class="{ 'active': isActive }"`.

3. ❌ DO NOT write JSX syntax (`{variable}`) inside HTML text.
   ✅ ALWAYS write `<span hx-text="variable"></span>`.

4. ❌ DO NOT escape quotes inside attribute strings if it can be avoided.
   ✅ ALWAYS write `<script type="application/json" hx-state>` inside the component wrapper.

5. ❌ DO NOT import client-side frameworks (`import React`, `import Vue`, `import Alpine`).
   ✅ HTMX PRO runs natively via `<script src="/htmx-bolt.js"></script>`.
